cases.reason: Brief 2 has one kind of plan. Main's case asserted a separate route for speech and presentation goals: a "BUILD WITH GUIDANCE" mode label, a build-rehearse-refine starting approach and no placement request. On this branch those goals go through the same topic-queue path as every other goal. They still get artifact-shaped topics (src/lib/plan-generation/knowledge-map-fallback.ts: audience and argument, evidence and draft, rehearsal), but not the separate mode, label or placement bypass. Behaviour change, not a lost check. Founder decision, 18 Sept 2026.
